## What's new in 2.0.0

**Brands live in their own design systems**
- A brand is now a Claude Design System with a Prism folder inside it (`project/prism/`). Adding or changing a brand no longer needs a plugin release.
- Each session brings in the brands you can open: it checks each design system's version and reads only what changed.
- Onboarding publishes a new or updated brand straight into its design system. Only that design system's editors and owners can do this; everyone who can open it has the brand in their next session.
- The Prism section of each design system's brand book shows the brand's writing rules (its digest).
- The bundled brands (Case Amplify and Prism) still work as before, built from their pinned copies.

**Brand layouts**
- Prism default layouts for one-sheets: a sheet can lead with its title, a full-width photo (photo-led), one big figure (stat-first) or a side rail of figures and a quote (sidebar).
- A brand can have layouts of its own. Prism picks the one that fits the content, or you name one ("lead with the photo").
- An editor can arrange a sheet in design mode and say "save this as a layout". The order of its blocks becomes the layout's slots, and later pieces in that layout follow them.
- The swatch sheet ends with a page in every layout the brand has.

**Better pages for every brand**
- Text over a photo-led cover now reads on any photo: the build darkens the photo under the title only as much as each line needs.
- Headings balance their lines and paragraphs never leave one word alone on the last line, in every brand.
- A QR code's text in a closing card sits flush with its label in every card size.
- Core no longer carries one brand's choices: Inter's alternate glyphs, a closing card's QR layout and the "purple" ground moved to where they belong. The third ground on posts, slides and charts is now `.vivid` (`.purple` still works).

**Design mode**
- Stat-first sheets and sheets with a photo beside the title read back correctly: edits to the figure or the title come back as edits.

**For brand authors**
- The 16 gradient colors are now `prism-color-gradient-*` (they were `prism-color-header-*`; the old names keep working in profiles, layers and ornaments).

## Also since 1.1.0

- **Website pages** (1.3): a whole page for the brand's WordPress site, as block markup to paste into a draft, with its page settings and photos (`run.sh web`).
- **Website illustrations** (1.2): an animated UI mockup of one feature for a website feature page, with a bench page that previews it live (`run.sh illustration`).
- **Case Amplify carousels** (1.1.1): no point numbers, page counter or wave line; stat figures of 3 characters at most; charts on any panel.
